note: B25 Office de tourisme, top floor: the globe attic (Le grenier aux globes) under the pitched roof, camera at the top of the narrow stairs. Whitewashed walls, grey-brown oak beams, two skylights and a dormer window, pale grey floorboards; landmark: the enormous old globe with brass rings under the dormer. Feminine LEFT: cat in sunglasses strutting along the globe's brass ring (latitude); seal holding up a copper penny on the tip of a peninsula model (péninsule); crab waving a claw inside its own little fenced plot (enclave). CENTRE: old local woman in a shawl giving directions to two tourists beside the tall clock (autochtone, m/f); photographer with a box camera shooting a model mountain (géographique, adj). Masculine RIGHT: strongman lifting a huge tin can on a little land patch with a red flag (canton); hamster curled in half a globe shell (hémisphère); farmer in a straw hat in a little green van of vegetables (provincial); chef standing on top of the biggest model town (chef-lieu); owl in a hard hat laying out model streets on a drafting table (urbanisme). Exit: the stair opening in the floor, near right -> down to the gallery R_world_02 (the only way in or out). la berline moved to B23 (misfit). Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p3).
